notes.title: bug fixing is hard 2
notes.notes:
sorry for all the notifications, there is a very finnicky thing happening with godot and steam.
Where I upload the new version to steam, on a test branch and it works, but as soon as I put in public, the game breaks.

I am doing my best to try to fix this. So for the time being you can all play in the test branch, you just need to go in your game properties on steam by right clicking on the list, then beta, and where it says none you can click to then select test.

The game will then re-update and you will be able to play in case this version does not work
